propositions: A parent removed in Jira must clear the local parent_id inbound, but two independent layers previously suppressed the signal: the fetcher omitted absent parents from snapshots and the differ refused parent_id=None emits.
The original fix without peer evidence destroyed 63 parent edges in production because managed_refs cannot answer whether the peer ever had the parent—only that rebar set it locally.
Clears must fire only on positive evidence that the peer once carried the parent, persisted in binding_store as a per-binding observed state advanced each pass by reconcile._advance_peer_parent.
A fail-open read (parent_map degrading to {}, truncated pages) must never overwrite good observations with no-parent, or the next pass will re-clear by a longer route.
On first pass after fix lands, no binding carries recorded observations so nothing is cleared; the feature becomes live per-binding as observations accumulate and self-heals into correctness.
